name: J&W Butcher Club
oneLiner: A raw-meat membership for GTA households: pick your cuts with points, get them on your J&W route day every 2 to 8 weeks, with free delivery and a free Meal Butler cooked chicken pack in every box.
headline: It turns occasional freezer stock-ups into a recurring box on routes J&W already drives, at butcher-counter prices well below Toronto's premium shops, and uses a free cooked pack to move raw buyers into the higher-margin Meal Butler line.
focus: Recurring raw-meat boxes plus beef and lamb shares
mechanism: J&W sells three Concept box sizes, Starter $139 (28 points), Family $239 (48) and Freezer Fill $319 (66), delivered every 2, 4, 6 or 8 weeks. A point is about $5 of J&W's own shelf price, so members spend points on real cuts: the 4 kg portioned chicken breast case ($85, 17 pts), AAA top sirloin 7-8 oz ($10, 2 pts), Wagyu/Kobe AAA ground 1 lb ($14.99, 3 pts) or the AAA ribeye 10 x 11-12 oz pack ($175, 35 pts), with steaks cut to the thickness they choose. Every box rides free on the member's normal route day (normally $20-35) and includes one free-for-life item, by default a Meal Butler cooked chicken 4 x 4 oz pack. Boxes lock at the Sunday cut-off, and members can skip, swap or pause online. The top of the range is beef and lamb shares, 1/16 ($325), 1/8 ($625) and the existing $1,200 quarter, each with a cut sheet, planning weight and deposit and pooled into whole quarters before cutting. The launch targets shoppers from Wild Fork's closing Whitby, Oakville, Ancaster and Newmarket stores.

modelledOn.name: truLOCAL
modelledOn.short: Points-built meat subscription boxes with a free item for life
modelledOn.what: Subscription meat boxes in three serving-sized tiers (Starter $155 up to 36 servings, Family $279 up to 80, Mega $349 up to 104). Members spend a points budget on cuts, can buy extra points, get a reminder 48 h before billing, and can skip, pause or cancel online. New members pick one free item for every box for life. One-time curated and value boxes, a comparison table against grocery and other boxes, and a corporate gifting funnel round it out.
modelledOn.proof: 70,100+ customers and 511,000+ boxes since 2016 (company claim). About $19.8M revenue in 2020, then acquired by EMERGE Commerce for up to $16.8M. 2025 AOV about $240, CLTV approaching $2,000, CAC $100-175 (EMERGE, Jan 21, 2026). Net new subscriptions +193% YoY in Feb 2025. Weak spot: Trustpilot 3.2/5 from 68 reviews, with thawed-box and price-per-lb complaints.
modelledOn.jwEdge: J&W cuts, portions and vacuum-seals in its own Ontario-inspected plant. It sells AAA ribeye at about $23-25/lb in the 10-pack vs $39-60/lb at Toronto premium butchers, and offers Wagyu, bison, venison, Ontario lamb and cut-to-thickness steaks truLOCAL does not. It delivers on its own weekly GTA routes instead of by courier, has a cooked Meal Butler line to use as the free item, and holds Google 4.8 stars from 611 reviews.

mathYear1: Members ramp 0->247 from Dec 2026 (Nov = build + waitlist): 415 joins (55 Dec, then 30-40/mo), 11% monthly churn -> 1,772 member-months x 0.95 boxes = 1,683 boxes x $235 avg order ($220 box + $15 add-ons) = $395.5K; + shares $34.0K (30 x 1/16 at $325 + 15 x 1/8 at $625 + 8 x 1/4 at $1,200 + 8 whole lamb at $475 + 6 half lamb at $250) = $429.6K gross x 0.75 incremental = $322K new revenue (low $169K: 249 joins, 13% churn, $215 AOV; high $484K: 540 joins, 9.5% churn, $245 AOV, 0.80 incremental)
mathRunRate: Year 2: 36 joins/month at 11% churn -> average 287 active members (steady state ~327) x 0.95 boxes x 12 = 3,268 boxes x $235 = $768.0K + shares $47.6K (1.4 x year 1) = $815.6K gross x 0.75 incremental = $612K a year (low $305K, high $957K)
mathNotes: Churn check: truLOCAL's CLTV (~$2,000) / AOV (~$240) implies ~8 lifetime orders; our 0.95 boxes/month / 11% churn = 8.6 lifetime boxes. 11% sits between replenishment (5-8%) and meal-kit (8-15%) churn.
0.95 boxes per active member per month = cadence mix (15% every 2 wks, 60% every 4, 15% every 6, 10% every 8 = 1.14 scheduled) less 12-15% skips.
Average box $220 = tier mix 35% Starter $139 / 45% Family $239 / 20% Freezer Fill $319; plus $15 of extra points and Meal Butler add-ons = $235, just under truLOCAL's ~$240 AOV.

Margin 30% blended (model-assumptions raw boxes 25-35%). Build-up: ~35% shelf margin on portioned raw, less the free item (~4.5 pts), tote and liner (~1.4 pts) and Freezer Fill bonus points (~0.6 pts) = ~28.5% on the box; $15 add-ons at 45% lift the blend to ~30%.
Incrementality 0.75 (low end) because some existing J&W raw buyers will simply join.
Cannibalisation not covered by the factor: ~25% of boxes x ($20 route fee forgone + ~$10 free item) = ~$12.6K in year 1 and ~$24.5K in year 2, deducted in contribution.
No separate Wild Fork line: the earlier $225K switcher estimate is not added. Those households are counted inside the 415 joins to avoid double counting.

Contribution (est.): year 1 = $322K x 30% = $96.6K - ~$60.4K operating - $11K setup - ~$12.6K cannibalisation = ~+$12.6K. Year 2 = $183.6K - ~$76.8K - ~$24.5K = ~+$82K/yr. This is a low-margin, steady play.
Sanity check vs J&W's ~$2.5M: year-1 gross Club revenue is ~17% of revenue and new revenue is +13%; run-rate is +24%. That is ~63 boxes and ~1,250 lb of frozen raw a week in year 2.
Acquisition year 1 ~$25.3K (ads $18K + founding credits $2.7K + referral credits $4.6K) = ~$61 blended, ~$82 per paid member (model range $60-120).

agentNeeds.name: Box Reminder & Save agent (shared: Auto-reorder and subscription agent)
agentNeeds.job: Texts each member 3 days before the Sunday cut-off with their picks (reply YES, SKIP or SWAP), handles swaps in plain language within the points budget, runs the cancel-save flow (skip, slower cadence, smaller box, pause) inside owner rules, and chases failed payments.
agentNeeds.onScreen: Team view: Thursday reminder SMS in Approvals and the Retention queue. Customer view: My Club skip, pause and cancel flow.

agentNeeds.name: Butler Concierge
agentNeeds.job: Answers members on chat, SMS and Instagram about points, delivery day by town, shares and thawed packs. Sends refunds, allergy questions and out-of-Ontario requests to staff.
agentNeeds.onScreen: Ask the Butler chat; Concierge log with a $9.99 thawed-pack credit awaiting approval.

agentNeeds.name: Production forecast & pick-list agent
agentNeeds.job: After the Sunday cut-off, totals every Club box and free item into Monday's pick list: cases to pull, steaks to cut by thickness, cooked chicken packs to pull from Meal Butler stock.
agentNeeds.onScreen: Team view: Monday pick list table with Approve button.

agentNeeds.name: Carcass & share-pooling agent (shared: Carcass and cut-yield optimiser)
agentNeeds.job: Pools 1/16 and 1/8 share orders into full quarters before a cut date, suggests Cut of the month point deals for overstocked cuts, and logs yield per quarter so planning weights become real weights.
agentNeeds.onScreen: Team view: Beef share board and the short-rib Cut of the month proposal in Approvals.

agentNeeds.name: Route & delivery agent
agentNeeds.job: Slots Club boxes into existing route days, shows new stops and added minutes per route, adds dry ice to long-haul boxes and sends delivery-window texts the day before.
agentNeeds.onScreen: Team view: Route impact table by day.

agentNeeds.name: Lifecycle marketing agent
agentNeeds.job: Drafts waitlist, welcome, Wild Fork-town, share-season (BBQ, Greek Easter May 2 2027, fall freezer fill) and win-back emails in J&W's voice for owner approval.
agentNeeds.onScreen: Team view: spring email to 412 Wild Fork-town waitlist sign-ups in Approvals.

agentNeeds.name: Paid ads optimiser
agentNeeds.job: Runs geo-targeted Meta and Google ads in Club towns (Whitby, Oakville, Ancaster, Newmarket first), reads CAC by town weekly and proposes budget moves under a monthly cap.
agentNeeds.onScreen: Team view: 'Move $10/day from Mississauga to Newmarket' proposal in Approvals.

assumptions: Soft launch Tue Dec 1 2026 (cut-off Sun Nov 29); November is build and waitlist with no revenue.
415 joins in year 1 (55 in December, 30-40 a month after); 36 a month in year 2.
11% monthly churn and 0.95 boxes per active member per month.
$235 average order: $220 box (35/45/20 tier mix) plus $15 extra points and Meal Butler add-ons.
A box point is about $5 of J&W shelf price; J&W's raw shelf prices hold through year 1.
Route stop cost $10 (model range $8-14); 70% of Club boxes are new stops.
Share planning weights (quarter ~100-120 lb take-home) are estimates until J&W weighs a test quarter.
Year-1 shares: 30 x 1/16, 15 x 1/8, 8 x 1/4, 8 whole lamb, 6 half lamb; year 2 is 1.4x.
Wild Fork switchers are inside the join numbers, not a separate revenue line.
J&W's vans and route times keep boxes frozen; long-haul boxes get an insulated tote with gel or dry ice.
Shopify Subscriptions (or Recharge/Loop) plus a bundle app can run the points builder; custom code is the fallback.
Gift memberships, if offered, are sold and counted in Play 5, not here.
risks: Thin margin: raw is ~30%. The free item and free delivery can push a Starter box under 25% if J&W's real shelf margin is below 35%. Confirm SKU costs before launch and cut bonus points first.
Cannibalisation: existing raw buyers join and stop paying $20-35 route fees. Track each member's spend before joining; the $139 minimum box protects order size.
Churn above 11% (meal kits run 8-15%). Mitigate with skip and pause, slower cadences, the Thursday reminder and payment retries (failed payments cause about half of subscription churn).
Cold chain and capacity: year 2 adds ~1,250 lb a week of frozen volume. Check van and Brimley freezer space and route times, especially Friday long-haul.
Share weights are unpublished today; weigh a test quarter and sell with a guaranteed minimum take-home weight to avoid disputes.
Using the Wild Fork name in ads raises trademark and ad-platform policy issues. Use factual town and date messaging after a legal review.
Ontario-only: J&W is provincially inspected, so Club boxes cannot leave Ontario.
Meat cost inflation (truLOCAL's parent cited higher meat COGS in Q1 2026). Review point values quarterly.
A points-budget builder may need a paid bundle app or custom Shopify work.
Overlap with Play 1 (cooked plans) and Play 5 (gifting): keep the Club raw-only plus shares.
who: Club lead (an existing online or counter staffer): ~8 h/week at launch rising to ~15 h/week by year 2 (packing ~10 min a box, member messages the agents can't close, approving drafts). Head butcher: ~3 h/week (cut-to-thickness steaks, share cut sheets, pooled-quarter cutting, yield log). Owner: ~1 h/week approving offers, ad budgets and save-flow rules. Drivers: ~22 extra stops a week by Apr 2027 and ~44 by year 2, on existing route days.

costs.note: Setup: 500 reusable insulated Club totes ~$5,000, photography of cuts and boxes $2,500, printed cut sheets, inserts and labels $1,000, subscription/bundle app setup and testing (~40 staff h) $1,000, test-quarter weigh and yield test $500, launch landing page and ad creative by staff $1,000. Monthly at run-rate (year-1 average ~$5,000): paid geo ads $1,400, first-box and referral credits ~$460, route stops ~$1,900 (272 boxes x 70% new stops x $10), Club lead ~15 h/wk ~$1,690, head butcher ~3 h/wk ~$390, apps, SMS, Klaviyo share and AI tokens ~$450, tote replacement ~$150. Packaging liners and the free item sit inside the 30% gross margin. Excludes the Minastech fee.

prototype.concept: A clickable, mobile-first J&W Butcher Club page that does truLOCAL's best ideas (tier picker, points-budget box builder, free-for-life item, tap-to-explain comparison table, self-serve membership) the J&W way: real J&W cuts and prices, $/lb on every card, cut-to-thickness steaks, route-day delivery and Meal Butler cooked chicken as the free item. It adds beef and lamb shares with real cut sheets and deposits, plus a Wild Fork-town route finder. The JW team view shows a modelled week in April 2027: KPIs, the Monday pick list, route impact, agent drafts to approve, a retention queue, the share board and a monthly P&L.
prototype.wow: The box fills as you shop. A top-down freezer box fills with a tile for each pack (real J&W photo and name, sized by weight). A sky-blue points meter fills and a live line updates ('21.3 lb · about 68 servings · $11.22/lb'). The slate-purple free-for-life tile is pinned in a corner from the start. When points hit the budget, the lid closes with a navy laurel seal reading 'Packed at 2201 Brimley Rd' and the button changes to 'Join with this box'.

design.inspiredBy: truLOCAL's page structure (offer hero, value pillars, 3 steps, plan picker, points builder, tap-to-explain comparison table, social proof, story cards, closing CTA, floating order button), rebuilt with J&W's own identity: navy laurel, butcher-paper cream, oxblood buttons and heritage serif type. No truLOCAL green, copy, logos or photos.

design.layout: Mobile-first single column with 16 px gutters; desktop 12-column grid where the builder is a menu (8 cols) beside a sticky box panel (4 cols). Bands alternate cream and white, with two deep-navy bands (hero, price comparison) and a navy closing CTA. Card radius 14 px, pill buttons 48 px tall, Barlow Condensed 600 uppercase for badges, point chips and $/lb tags. Sticky bottom box bar on mobile once a box size is chosen.
design.tone: Plain, warm, proud family butcher speaking as 'we'. Short sentences, specific numbers, Canadian spelling, no hype. Every concept price is labelled Concept and every weight or serving count est.

customerFlows.name: A. Join with a Family box (Whitby)
steps: In the hero type 'Whitby' and tap Check my day: 'Tuesday route. Club delivery is free (non-members pay $20).'
Tap Build my box, choose Family and keep Every 4 weeks.
In Free-for-life keep Meal Butler cooked chicken and pick Teriyaki.
In Build your box tap the Greek Sunday preset (47 pts) and add one ground chicken breast: the meter hits 48/48 and the lid closes with the Brimley Rd seal.
Add Lemon Chicken Rice Soup ($8.99) from Meal Butler extras.
Tap Review my box: picks, thickness notes, 'Next box: Tuesday, Dec 1 · Whitby', founding credit −$30.

Tap Join and check out: JWC.checkout({title:'Join the J&W Butcher Club · Family box', city:'Whitby', items:[Family box $239 with picks as note, free item $0, soup $8.99], subscription:{label:'Butcher Club · every 4 weeks', discountPct:0}, extraRows:[{label:'Club delivery credit', amount:-20}, {label:'Founding member credit', amount:-30}], note:'Box locks Sunday 11:59 pm before your route day.'}).
Place demo order: onPlaced saves the membership to JWC.store('club'), toast 'Welcome to the Butcher Club', My Club shows the next box, and the team view lists the new member.

customerFlows.name: B. Wild Fork switcher (Oakville)
steps: Tap the founding ribbon link 'Wild Fork closing near you?'.
Tap the Oakville chip: 'Thursday route. Join by Sunday, Nov 29 and your first box comes Thu, Dec 3. Club delivery is free (normally $27).'
Tap Start with the Switcher box: Family selected and preset loaded (48 pts, ~21.3 lb, ~68 servings, ~$11.22/lb).
Optionally switch the free item to Wagyu/Kobe AAA ground.
Tap Review my box, then Join and check out: JWC.checkout with city 'Oakville', 'Club delivery credit' −$27 and 'Founding member credit' −$30.
Place demo order and see the confirmation.

customerFlows.name: C. Reserve a 1/8 beef share
steps: Tap See beef shares in the hero.
On the 1/8 beef card tap See cut sheet.
Choose steaks 1¼" in packs of 2, roasts 3–4 lb, ground in 1 lb bags, keep short ribs and brisket, grind flank and skirt.
See 'Next pooled quarter: Wed, Dec 9 · 1 of 2 eighths reserved'.

Tap Reserve with $150 deposit: JWC.checkout({title:'Reserve your 1/8 beef share', items:[{id:'share-eighth-deposit', name:'1/8 beef share deposit (Concept)', price:150, qty:1, note:<cut sheet summary>}], extraRows:[{label:'Club delivery credit', amount:-fee}], note:'Balance $475 due on delivery or pickup, by the cut date.'}).
Place demo order and see the confirmation; the share board in team view shows Q pool 2 of 2 eighths.

customerFlows.name: D. Manage my membership
steps: Tap My Club (demo) in the nav (a demo member is loaded if none exists).
Tap Skip this box: confirm, the next date moves one cycle, toast 'Skipped. Next box Tue, Dec 29.'
Tap Cancel membership and choose 'Freezer's full'.
See the offer 'Every 8 weeks instead' and tap Accept.
Demo confirmation toast: 'Done. You're now every 8 weeks. Next box Tue, Jan 26.' and the status card updates.

customerFlows.name: E. Ask the Butler
steps: Open the chat and tap the suggestion 'How do points work?' to get the points reply.
Type 'What's in a 1/8 share?': the reply offers an 'Open 1/8 cut sheet' action.
Tap the action to open the cut sheet modal, then continue as flow C to the deposit checkout.

chat.name: Ask the Butler
chat.greeting: Hi, I'm the Butler. Ask me about Club boxes, points, beef shares or your delivery day.
suggestions: Wild Fork closed. Do you deliver to Oakville?

rules.reply: Each cut has a point price, about $5 of our shelf price per point. An 11–12 oz AAA ribeye is 5 points, an 8–9 oz Wagyu striploin is 7, a 1 lb bag of ground chicken breast is 2. Extra points are $5. Up to 5 unused points roll to your next box.
Skip, swap, pause or cancel online until Sunday 11:59 pm before your route day. No contract, no fee. Try it in My Club (demo).
Every box includes one free item while you're a member: Meal Butler cooked chicken 4 x 4 oz in your flavour, 1 lb Wagyu/Kobe AAA ground, or a wild sockeye fillet.

Beef shares come as 1/16 ($325), 1/8 ($625) and 1/4 ($1,200, our current price). The 1/16 and 1/8 are concept prices built from the quarter. Weights are planning estimates until we weigh a test quarter. Reserve with a deposit and pick your cuts on the cut sheet.
Sorry your store is closing. We deliver frozen, vacuum-sealed meat to Whitby on Tuesdays, Oakville and Ancaster on Thursdays, and Newmarket on Fridays. Club delivery is free.
Pick 1, 1¼ or 1½ inch on any steak. We cut it before it's vacuum-sealed and frozen.

Starter is up to 45 servings (about 10–14 lb on a mixed box), Family up to 80 (17–25 lb) and Freezer Fill up to 110 (25–34 lb). These are estimates at 5 oz raw per serving. Steak-heavy boxes weigh less.

Our chicken is Ontario-raised, air-chilled and grain-fed, with no hormones or antibiotics. Our beef is graded AAA, with Wagyu and Canadian Prime available. We don't make grass-fed claims on the Club menu. Ask the counter about a specific cut.
We're an Ontario-inspected plant, so our meat stays in Ontario. Our Friday long-haul route reaches Ottawa, Kingston, London, Windsor and more.

Our AAA ribeye is about $23–25/lb in the 10-pack, and our 4 kg chicken breast case works out to $9.64/lb. Toronto premium butchers were at $39–60/lb for ribeye on Oct 16, 2026. See 'Price per pound, side by side' on this page.
